note: Opt-in island variant (open the game with ?island=realistic). The streamed realistic Viking island shares island A's layout and coordinate frame, so destination positions and landmarks are island A's originals (git fc54e59). Only positions and texts are overridden; quests, unlock rules, NPC ids and dialogue come from world.json and explore.json unchanged. NPC/object 'at' and 'spawn' are Blender coordinates (x east, y north), like explore.json; destination positions are Three.js [x, z], like world.json.

landmarks.signal-woods: The forest hamlet with the round signal tower on the island's south shore.
landmarks.viking-workshop: The timber workshops west of the village square.
landmarks.trading-market: The harbour market beside the longship docks.
landmarks.great-hall: The Jarl's longhouse on the eastern hillside.
landmarks.web-frontier: The lookout tower at the end of the northern pier.
